symptom: The research command completed and emitted a valid summary, but the workflow concluded failure after the managed npm cache could not reserve its shared key.
lesson: Classify the research payload result separately from post-job infrastructure. A red workflow does not prove the research command failed when its validated summary completed successfully.
guardrail: Do not rerun protected N2 work only to diagnose this fingerprint. Remove the conflicting managed cache from the affected workflow and verify on the next natural schedule.
